risk_note: Money path, RV2. The positive settlement-difference batch approval / rejection and the candidate list (FU-SETTLE-ADJ-POSITIVE, BR-FUND-09 ②; D10-769, D10-770 ①–④; contract CT-24zv). Approval (fund.settle_adjust, step-up totp, idempotent standard mode: each order on its own transaction and the audit on another, one connection at a time per request, the admin pool holding 3 — B2-09x) recomputes each order of the batch under its order-key lock from orders.settle_commission_fen with the snapshot reserve and ratios and the current nets: a seq or commission_version that moved → voided_stale_seq; candidates voided by a clawback → voided_by_clawback; already decided → already_decided; difference 0 → approved_zero with no voucher; otherwise SETTLE_ADJUST USER:INCREASE ({order_key}:{uid}:{role}:ADJ:{seq}) and the platform by sign (PLATFORM:INCREASE / DECREASE, {order_key}:PLATFORM:ADJ:{seq}), the booked pair by CAS, a rebate history row SETTLE_POSITIVE_DIFF_APPROVED (R10), candidates approved by row_version CAS. A member in a normal state is credited in full and an open obligation closes as done; frozen / appealing defer (an open obligation kept, else a deferred one opened by R10); banned, deleting / deleted, a minor's promotion share and a forfeited share go to the platform (an open obligation forfeited with its event; the reason recorded in the audit, money r1 S1-2). One order failing leaves it pending and fails the call after the others and the audit (5xx, not stored). The batch is confirmed once nothing of it is pending. Rejection (idempotent transactional mode) rejects every pending candidate and confirms the batch, no voucher. The body is validated after the guard in the contract's order (permission → step-up → body → batch_id), the write routes mounting the contract's path and header schemas only (precedent B1-12z). int64 fen leave as JSON numbers through fenToJsonNumber (money r1 S0-2). Money r1 S1-1 (standard mode: if the idempotency completion write fails or the process dies after everything committed, a retry under the same key after the lease answers 20902 instead of the first result) is the standard mode's stated semantics (idempotency/index.ts §4), kept per D10-893; follow-up FU-IDEMPOTENCY-TAKEOVER-RESULT (low, after launch). Money r4 S1 (no voucher can carry the reason): an audit settle_adjust_share_forfeited in the order's own transaction (D10-928). Closing a forfeited obligation references this transaction's platform voucher, null when the platform difference is 0 (BR-FUND-04 ⑫, main #2704).

reviews.note: Codex via codex-run.sh (D10-823), effort medium (D10-884), base the last test(spec) commit after the rebase. r1 (money-review-r1.json) fail: S0 'unsupported…' was the reverse of main's newer clawback-order.ts change (the branch base lagged; rebased onto fcbe8ba); S0 int64 through Number() → fenToJsonNumber; S1 the forfeit reason not recorded → audit forfeits; S1 standard-mode retry after a lost completion answers 20902 → kept as the stated semantics per D10-893 (FU-IDEMPOTENCY-TAKEOVER-RESULT, low, after launch). r2 (money-review-r2.json) fail: S1 the reason only in the batch audit → carried in the voucher memo inside the order's transaction (BR-CALC-13, as credit-order.ts); S2 credited_fen checked after commit → fenToJsonNumber before commit. Then a read-only Fable 5.1 adversarial review (D10-883, not a counted round): no S0; S1 ledger.post duplicate ignored (only with void_on_clawback off) → the order fails and rolls back; S2 done obligations without voucher_id → set; other S2 kept (a three-way lock cycle PG breaks without a double posting, the memo fallback on another member's voucher, amounts only in vouchers when the audit transaction fails, a commission_version mismatch reusing voided_stale_seq). r3 (money-review-r3.json) fail: S1 the r2 guard 'forfeit with no voucher → throw' is reachable (1009 → 1010, one member banned, one frozen, the platform's rounding −1 cancelling the forfeit +1) and left the order pending for good → the throw removed, the reason stays in the batch audit in that case. r4 (money-review-r4.json; extra round, owner approval ops/approvals.yaml id 53, D10-925) fail: S1 with no voucher to carry it (the 1009 → 1010 case) the forfeit reason lived only in the batch audit, so a failed batch audit lost it for good since a retry only answers already_decided → per D10-928 an audit settle_adjust_share_forfeited in that order's own transaction, committing with booked / candidates / obligations (27c004660 before the rebase). r5 (money-review-r5.json; extra round, owner approval ops/approvals.yaml id 56, D10-1066; the attempt counter stays at 3 of 3, which does not read approvals, as for r4) pass with no findings, Codex medium, incremental over the r4 head: the two commits after it, the fix above and the rebase adaptation to main #2704 (B2-04zzb, voucher_id now required when closing an obligation: a forfeit references this transaction's platform voucher, null with closed_ref as fallback when the platform difference is 0; accepted into the r5 scope by D10-1078). r5 confirmed the null branch matches clawback-order.ts.

Red: red/3 ok, 48 tests in 9 files. Mutations (couli-runs/B2-09zc/mutations.md): held at approval, platform sign, stale seq, batch confirmation with pending — each red.
